stem: Tickets for a T20 cricket match in Rawalpindi go on sale online. The number of tickets still available \(h\) hours after sales open is given by \(R(h) = 18{,}000 - 1{,}250h\). How many hours after sales open will 5,500 tickets still be available?
verify:
h = symbols('h')
sol = solve(Eq(18000 - 1250*h, 5500), h)
assert sol == [10]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
